responsibility: Provides the x86_64-specific Darwin subtarget header layered on top of the main i386 Darwin configuration. Its stable role is to select the default Darwin architecture and multilib subarch as x86_64 versus i386 based on `-m32`, and to override the libgcc/linker spec for 64-bit macOS so exception-unwinding libraries are chosen according to `mmacosx-version-min`, including the special static-libgcc/libSystem ordering needed for newer Darwin unwinder behavior; in other words, it is the narrow 64-bit Mach-O spec and runtime-link policy companion to `darwin.h`, not the general Darwin backend configuration itself.
